2026_03_PHI_CHI.headline: Philadelphia’s front tests Chicago’s protection in a matchup of explosive-play ceilings
2026_03_PHI_CHI.paragraph1: Philadelphia can dictate this matchup if its defensive front turns Chicago’s protection into the central story, particularly on obvious passing downs. The Bears need Caleb Williams operating on schedule, with the run game and quick concepts reducing the burden on the tackles. Philadelphia’s offense presents the opposite stress: enough rushing and quarterback mobility to force disciplined run fits before attacking downfield. Chicago must prevent explosive plays while still generating pressure, a difficult balance against the Eagles’ multidimensional attack.
2026_03_PHI_CHI.model_rationale: Philadelphia can create pressure without abandoning its broader defensive structure, while Chicago needs efficient early downs to keep Williams away from repeated high-leverage protection situations.
